etsy.title: Skirt Block Sloper Pattern PDF, Women's Straight Skirt Basic Block XS-3X, A4 Letter A0 Sewing Pattern, Pattern Drafting Base
etsy.description:
A clean, simple skirt block (sloper) to start your own skirt designs. Fitted straight skirt with darts, nested sizes XS to 3X, ready to print at home or at a copy shop.

WHAT IT IS
A block is the basic fitted shape pattern makers use as a starting point. Trace your size, make a quick test version in cheap cotton, adjust it to your body, and you have a personal base for pencil skirts, A-line skirts and more.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• Front (cut on fold) and back pattern pieces with darts and hip line
• Nested sizes XS, S, M, L, XL, 2X, 3X (see the size chart image)
• A4 and US Letter print-at-home files with a test square
• A0 copy shop file
• Step-by-step guide: printing, choosing your size, cutting, sewing a test skirt, fitting tips, from block to pencil and A-line skirt
• Everything in English AND German (Deutsch): two downloads

GOOD TO KNOW
• No seam allowance included (add your own; 1.5 cm / 5/8 in is common).
• Ease: 4 cm (1.5 in) at the hip, 1 cm at the waist. Length 60 cm (23.5 in).
• Drafted with the help of software from a standard size chart. Please sew a test version first: every body is different.
• Skill level: confident beginner.

DEUTSCH: Grundschnitt für einen geraden Rock mit Abnähern, Größen XS–3X ineinander, A4/Letter und A0, Anleitung auf Deutsch. Ohne Nahtzugabe.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. PDF pattern only, no physical item will be shipped.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales. Please don't share or resell the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
